outlook.statement: Business remains closely linked to investment cycle in new projects, industrial capacity expansions, and sentiment across manufacturing and infrastructure sectors. Steady demand from capex-intensive industries supported by positive government signals including increased infrastructure outlays, PLI schemes, and focus on logistics and supply chain modernization. Committed to strengthening market competitiveness through improved supply chain efficiency, cost optimization, and continuous product portfolio refinement. Actively strengthening global reach through targeted export initiatives and strategic partnerships in key international markets, with focus on scaling footprint across Middle East and Africa. Key pillar of growth strategy is accelerated scale-up of subsidiary businesses (SWIFT and Daedalus) as independent growth engines. Continuing to invest in expanding product offerings organically and through collaborations. Sharpening focus on penetrating new and emerging customer segments including data centres. Accelerated digitization of business data, workflows, and service processes with integration of AI- and ML-driven analytics. Mindful of potential headwinds such as policy shifts, geopolitical instability, fluctuations in metal prices and freight costs, supply chain disruptions, and delays in customer approvals or project execution.
